patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Right leg weakness and unsteady gait

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Known history of HIV, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Noncompliance with medications for over 2 years.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: The patient is somnolent and slightly confused, oriented to person but not to place or time. Mild lymphadenopathy is noted.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with right leg weakness, unsteady gait, multiple falls, forgetfulness, and paranoid behavior.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, for about a week now my right leg feels weak and I’ve been unsteady, so I’ve had multiple falls. Over the last six months I’ve gotten forgetful—losing my way on familiar routes—and I’ve been having trouble using simple things in the kitchen.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like areas where the skin is scratched, rubbed raw, or has small open spots—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m not sure—I haven’t noticed any particular areas of my skin that are scratched or rubbed raw.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been told that you stop breathing during sleep, or have you noticed episodes where you briefly stop breathing and then gasp or wake up? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t been told that I stop breathing during sleep, and I don’t recall episodes where I briefly stop and then gasp or wake up.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain in one spot, swelling or bruising that’s getting worse, trouble using the area, or visible deformity?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, after the falls I’ve had trouble using my right leg and I’m unsteady, but I don’t recall severe pain in one specific spot, obvious swelling or bruising getting worse, or any visible deformity.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist compared to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), either recently or after an injury?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any bruising or dark discoloration on my chest wall after my falls.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual—no clear increase in frequency or volume.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs (including non-prescribed use)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t use tobacco or cannabis, and I don’t take opioids or stimulants. I drink alcohol only rarely, and I haven’t been using any other non-prescribed drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine, and I haven’t had episodes where I can’t make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion—such as a new spot, sore, mole, or patch that’s growing, changing color, bleeding, or not healing?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t recall any new or changing skin spots, sores, or moles that are growing, changing color, bleeding, or not healing.”
